observed_exact_user_return: LIVE/RIDE already feels delightful and embodied even at low visual resolution; jitter/motion is felt rather than merely read.

The biggest perceptual miss is macro musical consequence: large drops are being missed. Desired feeling is roller-coaster buildup/tunnel → massive plunge → sudden open sky / explosive spatial feedback.
User wants visual pattern changes to scale with meaningful musical structure, not generic combo fireworks.
Lyrics/text from song files would be valuable when actually present.
IDLE operating in FLOW is desirable.
WOOD/VOID synth scenes are not self-explanatory yet.
Playlist/tuning-map controls and source management remain valuable future work but are not the current bottleneck.
The linear explorer abstraction is beginning to make sense as a generic addressed stream: music now, potentially book/text/day/other sequence later.
LISTEN/radial viewer/annotation should gradually unify around shared microlib/formal mapping rather than become disconnected apps.

The same addressed annotation + mapping + compact visual language has strong future communications potential; possible outputs could be animated/gif-like text+visual messages or product-demo/Enter-the-Void-like temporal compositions.
Version coordination drift has been encountered and should be actively reduced.
reconstructed_vision: LIVE is not a racer skin over audio. It is an embodied projection of a linear addressed source where structure can become terrain and human operations can rewrite traversal.
The ring is not necessarily the source timeline itself; it is a cyclic control/state projection operating against a linear source address.
LISTEN is the inspect/annotate/map projection; LIVE is embodiment/traversal; GLYPH ATLAS is source memory/thumbnail; READFIELD can become the textual projection of the same addressed stream.
Comms should reuse addressed source/time, annotations, visual compression and RETURN rather than importing a score/combo metaphor.
implemented_this_pass: TRACKFIELD v0.5 introduces explicit MACRO DROP detection as a scale above beat/phrase/section texture.
Detected buildup→impact events create tunnel pressure, pre-climb, exaggerated plunge, speed kick, width opening and a one-shot open-sky burst.
Flat material has a negative test to prevent constant fake spectacle.
LIVE local source intake accepts audio plus optional LRC/VTT/SRT/TXT/MD sidecars.
Embedded MP3/M4A lyrics metadata is read when present.
Timed text follows actual cue addresses; unaligned embedded text is exposed as FLOAT / UNALIGNED rather than fake-synchronized.
IDLE preserves current FLOW/RATCHET mode; FLOW witness-play rotates continuously using source bend while remaining reversible/non-authorial.
WOOD/VOID/DEEP/TRANCE scene meanings are surfaced in settings.
laws: MACRO CONSEQUENCE MUST COME FROM MACRO SOURCE EVIDENCE, NOT EFFECT GAIN.
TIMED TEXT MAY CLAIM SOURCE ALIGNMENT; UNTIMED TEXT MUST NOT.
IDLE MAY BORROW SOURCE MOTION BUT NEVER PERSIST AUTHORSHIP.
THE LINEAR ADDRESS AND THE CYCLIC CONTROL PROJECTION ARE UNEQUAL.
COMMS TRANSFER = ADDRESS + ANNOTATION + PROJECTION + RETURN, NOT COMBO SCORE.

formal source-stream adapter so text/book/day/conversation can reuse traversal mechanics
compact animated comms RETURN: text + glyph/path + bounded motion/effects

human_gate: Use one familiar song with a known dramatic buildup/drop. If the source now produces anticipatory tunnel pressure, a felt plunge, and an open-sky release at roughly the right macro moment, keep/tune. If events are frequent or mislocated, tune detector thresholds before adding more FX.
